description: This file defines a Dagger dependency injection module for setting up the Room database instance for the application. It provides a singleton implementation of NiaDatabase using the Room database builder, annotated for dependency injection with Hilt.

classes.name: DatabaseModule
classes.description: A Dagger module installed in the SingletonComponent that provides the singleton NiaDatabase instance.

methods.name: providesNiaDatabase
methods.description: Provides a singleton NiaDatabase instance configured with the app context.
